description: Provides a JAWS-compatible experience in NVDA, including familiar keystrokes, layered commands, cursor modes, web navigation, and presentation options. It is designed to help JAWS users migrate to NVDA while retaining many familiar commands. Press NVDA+grave accent (`) at any time to toggle between JVDA and NVDA commands.
changelog: Initial public release with JAWS-style cursor, navigation, presentation, and help features.
